# FG-DB-0006

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`job-dead-lettered`](../../ops/runbooks/job-dead-lettered.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_job_that_fails_max_attempts_times_is_dead_and_reported` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: バックグラウンドの処理が完了できませんでした。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: A background task could not be completed. Contact the administrator.
- id: Tugas latar belakang tidak dapat diselesaikan. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

An internal job in forge.jobs gave up, or jobs of one kind pile up. reason=attempts_exhausted: its handler failed max_attempts times; permanent_failure: the handler reported a failure that can never succeed; lease_expired: its last lease expired (worker crashed, run cancelled, hung) with the attempts used up; dead_lettered (forge doctor jobs.dead): a job died within the last 24 h; queue_depth (forge doctor jobs.queue_depth): more than 1000 ready jobs of one kind (the queue is meant for internal work, never one job per edge device); queue_wait: the oldest ready job of a kind waits longer than 10 min (no forge worker runs, or none has a handler for the kind). The work of a dead job is not done until it is enqueued again.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The event carries `reason`, `job_id`, `kind`, `attempts`, `last_error_code` (the code of the last failure; FG-DB-0007 = its lease expired) and `origin_request_id` (the request or event that enqueued it — search the logs for it to follow request → event → job). The job runner logs the cause just before, under its own error_code with `job_id` / `kind` / `attempt`, sharing the same request_id. For queue_depth / queue_wait: `kind`, `ready` (capped at 100000+) and `oldest_wait_ms`. Read the row (read-only): SELECT id, kind, state, attempts, max_attempts, last_error_code, last_error, origin_request_id, created_at, finished_at FROM forge.jobs WHERE id = <job_id>; run `forge doctor --json` (jobs.dead, jobs.expired_leases, jobs.queue_depth).

## 対処 (fix)

Fix the cause named by last_error_code (its own runbook), then have the work redone by the command that owns the kind (never by editing forge.jobs by hand outside an approved runbook step). queue_wait: start `forge worker` or deploy the build that has the kind's handler; queue_depth: find the caller that enqueues per-item jobs and make it one job that walks its items.
